scope: Synthetic JSDOM fixtures; no actual cart mutations, orders, address storage, or live Shopify checkout acceptance. Native inventory/prices/quantity rules are fixture inputs. Tests cover editable line quantity, summed-unit shipping, native limits and validation without input recreation.
